purpose: Human involvement and uncertainty statements are separate from the 99 AI-action types. They occupy reserved IDs within the same version 2 code space.

categories.label: AI-capable software only
categories.description: AI-capable software was used, but the creator reports no known AI feature use in this work; available features alone are not evidence of use.

categories.label: Uncertain AI involvement
categories.description: The creator cannot establish whether AI contributed to one or more steps or inputs.

categories.label: Human source material
categories.description: Human-authored source material, designs, recordings, or code formed part of the input.

categories.label: Human direction
categories.description: A human supplied the goals, prompts, constraints, or creative direction.

categories.label: Human selection
categories.description: A human selected which AI suggestions or outputs to include.

categories.label: Human revision
categories.description: A human materially edited or reworked AI output before inclusion.

categories.label: Full human review
categories.description: A human reviewed all AI-affected portions of the declared work before release.

categories.label: Independent factual checks
categories.description: A human checked relevant factual claims against sources independent of the generating AI.

categories.label: Human-reviewed test results
categories.description: Tests were executed and their results reviewed by a human; this does not imply full coverage or correctness.

categories.label: Partial human review
categories.description: A human reviewed only some AI-affected portions of the declared work before release.

categories.label: No human output review
categories.description: The declared AI output was released without human review of that output.
